alt: Humerus and elbow joint. Proximal humerus: head (articulates with glenoid), anatomical + surgical necks, greater + lesser tubercles, intertubercular sulcus. Shaft: deltoid tuberosity, radial groove. Distal: medial + lateral epicondyles, trochlea (articulates with ulna), capitulum (articulates with radius), olecranon + coronoid + radial fossae.
